# Config Sheet oidcpro.config.section.General.label=General Configuration oidcpro.config.section.User.label=User Configuration oidcpro.config.section.Group.label=Group Configuration oidcpro.config.section.advanced=Advanced properties
oidcpro.config.property.skipped.label=Is skipped? oidcpro.config.property.skipped.hint=Defines whether the users can authenticate using this OIDC client or not.
oidcpro.config.property.configurationName.label=Configuration name oidcpro.config.property.configurationName.hint=The name of this OIDC configuration oidcpro.config.property.clientId.label=Client ID oidcpro.config.property.clientId.hint=The client id retrieved from the OIDC provider you want to connect to. oidcpro.config.property.clientSecret.label=Client Secret oidcpro.config.property.clientSecret.hint=The client secret retrieved from the same OIDC Provider. The secret is usually displayed only once so make sure to copy it as soon as you get your hands on it. oidcpro.config.property.authorizationEndpoint.label=Authorization Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.authorizationEndpoint.hint=The endpoint of your provider where XWiki will try to authorize itself using the client id and secret you provided. i.e. https://myprovider/openidconnect/auth oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpoint.label=Token Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpoint.hint=The provider endpoint from where XWiki will retrieve the access and refresh tokens. i.e. https://myprovider/openidconnect/token oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpoint.label=User Info Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpoint.hint=The provider endpoint where XWiki will retrieve the information of the user that wants to login. i.e. https://myprovider/openidconnect/userinfo oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpoint.label=Logout Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpoint.hint=If this property is filled, once the user logs out from XWiki, a logout request will also be sent to the OIDC provider, to the specified endpoint.
oidcpro.config.property.xwikiProvider.label=XWiki Provider oidcpro.config.property.xwikiProvider.hint=The URL to the xwiki instance that acts as an identity provider. Should only be used if xwiki serves as a provider. oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpointMethod.label=User Info Endpoint Method oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpointMethod.hint=The HTTP method that will be used when requesting the user information. i.e. GET, POST oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpointHeaders.label=User Info Endpoint Headers oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpointHeaders.hint=Any additional HTTP headers that need be used when requesting the user information. i.e. Accept:application/json,SomeOtherHeader:header value oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpointMethod.label=Logout Endpoint Method oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpointMethod.hint=The method that will be used to logout the user from the provider. i.e. POST, GET oidcpro.config.property.logoutMechanism.label=Logout Mechanisn oidcpro.config.property.logoutMechanism.hint=The mechanism that should be used in the case of logging out. i.e. rpInitiated oidcpro.config.property.responseType.label=Response Type oidcpro.config.property.responseType.hint=The response type that we want to get from the OIDC provider after a successful authorization. i.e. code (authorization code), token (access token), id_token. The default value is `code`. oidcpro.config.property.idTokenClaims.label=ID Token Claims oidcpro.config.property.idTokenClaims.hint=The claims/information that should be contained in the ID Token returned by the provider. i.e. acc, iss, exp. oidcpro.config.property.claims.label=Claims oidcpro.config.property.claims.hint=The claims, in json format, that are to be retrieved from the OIDC provider. This field should only be used if certain claims (i.e. acc) require a value, otherwise, the claims are constructed from the "Id Token Claims" and "User Info Claims" properties. oidcpro.config.property.afterLogoutURL.label=After-Logout URL oidcpro.config.property.afterLogoutURL.hint=The URL where the user should be redirected to after they logout oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpointMethod.label=Token Endpoint Method oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpointMethod.hint=The method that should be used when XWiki requests the tokens from the provided endpoint. oidcpro.config.property.tokenStorageScope.label=Token Storage Scope oidcpro.config.property.tokenStorageScope.hint=Defines where the retrieved tokens should be stored in the XWiki instance. i.e. NONE (no storage), WIKI (tokens will be stored at the wiki level), USER (tokens will be stored in the profile of each user - default).
oidcpro.config.property.userNameFormatter.label=Username Formatter oidcpro.config.property.userNameFormatter.hint=The format that will be used in order to generate the xwiki username of a user coming from the OIDC provider. i.e. ${oidc.issuer.host._clean}-${oidc.user.preferredUsername._clean} oidcpro.config.property.userSubjectFormatter.label=User Subject Formatter oidcpro.config.property.userSubjectFormatter.hint=The pattern to use to generate the unique identifier of the user in the OpenId Connect provider. i.e. ${oidc.user.subject} oidcpro.config.property.userMapping.label=User Attribute Mapping oidcpro.config.property.userMapping.hint=This property maps the attributes of the user coming from the OIDC provider to XWiki user attributes. i.e. if the OIDC provider stores the user email in a property named 'electronic-mail', we want to let XWiki know this by filling this property like so: electronic-mail=email.
oidcpro.config.property.userInfoClaims.label=User Info Claims oidcpro.config.property.userInfoClaims.hint=The user information that should be returned by the oidc provider. i.e.: sub, name, gender, given_name. oidcpro.config.property.userInfoRefreshRate.label=User Info Refresh Rate oidcpro.config.property.userInfoRefreshRate.hint=The time after which the user information should be refreshed (in milliseconds). oidcpro.config.property.userInfoSkip.label=User Info Skip oidcpro.config.property.userInfoSkip.hint=If this property is set, then XWiki will skip the retrieval of the user information from the specialised endpoint. Useful for OAuth providers.
oidcpro.config.property.enableUser.label=Enable User oidcpro.config.property.enableUser.hint=TODO:FILL
oidcpro.config.property.groupsClaim.label=Group Claims oidcpro.config.property.groupsClaim.hint=Define if user accounts should be enabled (marked as active) on first login. oidcpro.config.property.groupsMapping.label=Groups Mapping oidcpro.config.property.groupsMapping.hint=This property maps the groups coming from the OIDC provider to XWiki Groups. When a user coming from the OIDC provider logs in, they will also be added to the XWiki groups according to this mapping. i.e. OIDCGroupId=XWiki.AdminGroup
oidcpro.config.property.allowedGroups.label=Allowed Groups oidcpro.config.property.allowedGroups.hint=Regular expression that will be used to determine the groups that should be included in the synchronization process. If the incoming group matches this regex, then it will be synced. oidcpro.config.property.forbiddenGroups.label=Forbidden Groups oidcpro.config.property.forbiddenGroups.hint=Defines a list of groups that should not be able to login into xwiki. If an user belongs to one of the listed groups, access to xwiki will be forbidden. i.e. Group1,Group2. oidcpro.config.property.groupsMappingExclude.label=Groups Mapping Exclude oidcpro.config.property.groupsMappingExclude.hint=Regular expression that will be used to determine the groups that should not be included in the synchronization process. If the incoming group matches this regex, then it will not be synced.
